title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. translated_title: 超越语义ID：生成式推荐中的有限束可达性与连续查询生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12977v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：社交媒体平台的生成式推荐（GR）通常通过有限宽度的束搜索自回归地解码离散语义ID（SID）来检索物品。本研究考察了这种输出接口如何约束被留出的目标物品进入有限返回列表的可能性，同时区分了全目录可评分性与经验性Top-K支持。我们引入了两种连续查询范式：CQG-Single在单次传递中生成一个检索查询，CQG-AR则自回归地生成连续残差更新，在保留逐步解码的同时移除了SID物品词表、码本查找和离散束扩展。这些设计从而消除了由有限束解码导致的SID特定可达性约束，并避免了将离散SID词表与预训练主干模型向量空间对齐的技术难题。两种方法都使得每个被编码的物品可以通过稠密检索或近似检索直接评分……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出两种连续查询生成范式CQG-Single和CQG-AR，通过去除离散语义ID词表与束搜索机制，消除了生成式推荐中的有限束可达性约束，使目录中所有物品都能被直接评分与检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two continuous-query generation paradigms, CQG-Single and CQG-AR, which eliminate the finite-beam reachability constraint in generative recommendation by removing the discrete Semantic ID vocabulary and beam search, allowing every encoded item to be directly scored and retrieved.
